lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.delivery_public_availability(p_store_id uuid)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/delivery_public_availability`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.delivery_quote_coupon(p_store_id uuid, p_code text, p_subtotal numeric)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/delivery_quote_coupon`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

metadata.name: delivery_quote_coupon
metadata.arguments: p_store_id uuid, p_code text, p_subtotal numeric
